_doc: Awkward values for the Obsidian projection: null and wrongly typed content,
tags and stat; a path that needs percent-encoding; a listed note that is gone
by the time it is read; and files that are not notes, among them `.MD`, which
is not `.md`. The paths are the map keys, which the SDK's test mode stamps onto

a+b #c %d &e=f (1) Straße.md.content: A name that every encoder disagrees about.
